issues: identity_engine cannot compile: run() declares nonlocal stage, asks although neither name has an enclosing function binding. Its try/except cannot catch this syntax error.

Identity handling transfers a caller merely for giving an unclear answer or asking a question after the human-help question. It also mishandles human-help acceptance during a callback, ignores caller-first scam questions, and classifies repeated refusals to talk during name confirmation as unclear identity.

The collection evaluator can advance persuasion on an idle/result-only entry, while question, AI and scam classifications can repeatedly replay an offer without advancing the applicable non-answer budget.

Natural product references such as 'the credit card' and 'my personal loan' are permitted by extraction but not reliably resolved. Product-only items accompanying too_much or hardship can be mistaken for acceptance of existing payment terms.

Read-back corrections can use stale offered_terms instead of the terms actually read back. Date clarification can lose a counteroffer's need for acceptance, overwrite selected products, discard remaining proposals, or fall back to an earlier offer's date.

The date parser mishandles ordinary ordinal words and month-bearing vague periods. For example, a weekday followed by a spelled-out ordinal can be accepted as a different date, and 'end of November' does not establish November for the next day fragment.

The attempt-one calculation invents a next-week exception when this week's last business day is already past. Brief A authorizes that exception only when today is that business day; a Friday holiday or weekend exposes an unresolved source-policy gap.

Unclear replies to the hardship support offer are treated as declining support. Pending agreements can also survive an actual support refusal and lead back into confirmation instead of resolving the affected unrecorded products as hardship.

Promise failure and success instructions can be bypassed by the immediate result transition. Consequently, a twice-failed product need not be identified to the caller, and a transfer after a successful write can omit the required text-message sentence.

The shared action stage can process a transfer interruption after add_note has already succeeded, violating Brief B's prohibition on notes before any transfer. Operational holds also retain a routing flag that can repeatedly re-enter the action stage.

Action entry prompts interpolate unavailable state on pre-verification callback and transfer paths. Their delayed-interruption handling lacks an explicit action route for processing the retained reply.

The supplied checks do not cover these interacting failures. This audit is static; neither the existing checks nor the added prescribed-input checks establish actual phone-model extraction, routing or speech.
